sloka: विभीषणः तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षस चेष्टितः ।प्रख्यात वीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खर दूषणौ ॥३-१७-२३॥
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasa ceṣṭitaḥ ।prakhyāta vīryau ca raṇe bhrātarau khara dūṣaṇau ॥3-17-23॥

translations.english: My brother is Ravana, son of Visrava, and lord of all demons. You have heard his name I suppose.
